openQuestions: US-003 needs a `cam spec --write-docs` stdin-JSON entrypoint that parses a DomainDocsPayload from stdin and calls writeDomainDocsOnMain (this story's export from src/commands/domain-docs.ts). Note: a 'cam spec' subcommand already exists in src/commands (referenced in test output as sending '/cam-spec <id>' to the orchestrator pane) -- US-003 likely adds a new flag/mode to that existing command rather than a brand-new command file; read src/commands/spec.ts (or equivalent) first before assuming a fresh file.

commitTreeToMain's atomicity guarantee (CAS retry against refs/heads/main) means a concurrent domain-docs write racing another on-main writer (e.g. cam issue --file-local) will retry and rebuild the tree fresh each attempt; no special handling was needed here since commitTreeToMain already owns that retry loop.

ADR idempotency in writeDomainDocsOnMain is keyed on slugifyAdrTitle(title) matching the slug portion of an existing docs/adr/NNNN-<slug>.md filename. If a future story wants to update an EXISTING ADR's context/decision/consequences text (not just skip re-creating it), that requires new behavior (out of scope for US-002, which only guarantees no-duplicate-file idempotency, matching the acceptance criteria wording).

Extracted checkMainUpToDate/pushMainBestEffort as NEW exports on src/git/on-main.ts (used only by the new domain-docs.ts caller) to avoid a 5th verbatim copy tripping the jscpd gate; the other 4 existing private copies (issue-specify.ts, issue-file.ts, journal.ts, triage.ts) were deliberately left untouched per this story's notes (that dedup is CAM-124's scope, not this story's). A future dedup story could migrate those 4 callers onto the same src/git/on-main.ts exports (now parameterized with an actionLabel arg for the detached-head message).

Environment note (not a code defect, carried over from US-001): `bunx knip` (the check:all dead-code gate) crashes in this sandbox because system Node is v18.20.4 and knip's bundled colors.js imports node:util's styleText (Node 22+ only). typecheck, bun test, lint, embed-vendor:check, file-size, debt-markers, coverage, dup, and ci-parity are all green; only dead-code fails, and it fails identically on a clean checkout with no diff (confirmed: knip fails at import time before reading any source files).
